text:
mara-sales: FYI Cerulean wants a quick POC to test a cust-llama14b variant in Dedicated. Main asks: tokenizer parity, kv-cache support for 2048 rolling window, and whether q8_0 is safe for their generation quality. Can eng/ML confirm?

june-ml: Tokenizer parity first: need tokenizer.json + merges. If special tokens are different we can remap but need to test. q8_0 usually ok for 14B; we should run a small quality eval on their prompt set.

eli-eng: KV cache supports segmented windows; rolling 2048 is fine but alignment matters. We can run a sim if they provide a few sample conversations. For Dedicated POC perf, recommend reserved capacity.

sam-sre: Security: they expect CMK + audit logs. Dedicated supports wrapped-keys + audit. We need their network allowlist and retention requirements.

tara-legal: Also request model provenance/license and export-control checklist before we accept model binaries. I'll draft a short template.

mara-sales: Can we ask for a minimal artifact to run a compatibility smoke without full weights?

june-ml: Yes: tokenizer.json, model_config.json, and one shard or a small weight snapshot. That’s enough for tokenization and shape checks.

eli-eng: I'll push a tiny inspector script to them and open ticket. ops-bot: ticket DED-7123 created (owner: eli-eng).

mara-sales: Action items: (1) I'll request artifacts and sample convs; (2) @june-ml run smoke tests on receipt; (3) @eli-eng produce perf estimate for 2-GPU reserved pool; (4) @tara-legal send template. Will update thread. :thumbsup:
